name: Ductavo
tagline: Dispatch software for HVAC teams that refuse to sweat the small stuff.
positioning: Ductavo runs enterprise HVAC field operations end to end — dispatch, telemetry, and billing — so your techs stop babysitting spreadsheets in the truck.

hero.h1: Your HVAC ops shouldn't run on sticky notes and vibes.
hero.sub: Ductavo dispatches technicians, streams equipment telemetry, and bills by the job — one platform for the enterprise service teams keeping 40,000 rooftop units from quietly dying.

features.title: Dispatch that reads the traffic
features.description: Auto-route techs by skill, drive time, and SLA. When the ER walk-in cooler goes down at 4pm, Ductavo already knows who's closest and certified.

features.title: Live telemetry, no clipboard
features.description: Pull refrigerant pressures, amp draw, and runtime straight from connected units. Techs arrive knowing the diagnosis, not guessing at it.

features.title: Invoices that write themselves
features.description: Parts, labor, and truck rolls meter automatically per work order. The invoice is done before the tech pulls out of the parking lot.

features.title: Preventive maintenance on autopilot
features.description: Filter swaps, coil cleans, and compliance inspections get scheduled from asset history — not from someone's calendar reminder.

features.title: One roof, every site
features.description: Manage 12 buildings or 1,200 from a single portfolio view with per-location SLAs, warranties, and equipment lineage.

features.title: Alerts before the callback
features.description: Ductavo flags units trending toward failure so you dispatch a tune-up, not an emergency at holiday rates.

testimonials.quote: We were running dispatch out of three whiteboards and a group text. Ductavo cut our average response time by 34% and our techs stopped calling the office every hour.
testimonials.name: Marcus Bell

testimonials.quote: The telemetry alone paid for it. We caught a failing chiller compressor across 60 grocery sites before a single freezer thawed. That's the phone call I never got to dread.
testimonials.name: Priya Nayar

testimonials.quote: Usage billing means I'm not paying for seats that sit idle in the slow season. My CFO actually said something nice about a software renewal. First time.
testimonials.name: Doug Ferreira

pricing.blurb: For regional shops scaling past the whiteboard.
For multi-site operators who live and die by SLAs.
For national service networks with real integration needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ductavo keeps enterprise HVAC teams cool, calm, and billing on time. Fewer callbacks, faster trucks, invoices that don't wait.
